description: Train Station Maps (including Metro) is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Transport for NSW. This dataset provides WCAG 2.0 compliant wayfinding maps for 48 Sydney train stations and 13 Metro Stations. Each map displays entrances, lift locations, transport mode interchanges including bus ranks, taxi ranks and pick-up areas. Coverage: Transport for NSW. The portal files it under the publisher Transport for NSW. Its tags are NSW Trains, Sydney Metro, Sydney Trains, WCAG, facilities. It offers 108 resource(s) in PDF, ZIP. The portal shows 2026-06-26 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-3.0-AU. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
